Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on the recording, but you can note that I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where the collision happened?
A: It was an intersection in Pasadena, Texas, near a shopping center. I was heading down the main road when the
other car came toward me in my lane.
Q: How fast were you traveling?
A: Not fast at all. I was coming up on the light and slowing down. I'd say maybe fifteen miles an hour, maybe less.
Q: And the other vehicle?
A: It was also moving slowly. It drifted over and we met nearly head-on. It wasn't a hard hit, more like a crunch and a
shove.
Q: Did either airbag deploy?
A: No, nothing deployed. The car stopped pretty quiclky and I just sat there for a moment.
Q: Were you wearing a seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was belted in.
Q: Have you sought medical attention since the collision?
A: I went to urgent care the same afternoon. My neck was stiff and sore, and they diagnosed me with a neck strain.
I've been doing stretches and taking over-the-counter pain relief.
Q: Are you experiencing any pain or stiffness now?
A: Yes, mostly when I turn my head to check my blind spot, and it's worse in the mornings.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm cooperating fully and I can provide the urgent care paperwork whenever you need it.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
</page>
